verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no API for ReelMimic. Core actions like dropping in a reference, approving the plan, chatting for changes and commenting on the video are all described as UI interactions. The only programmatic surfaces are narrow npm CLI scripts for posting and setup checks, which are adjacent features and fall far short of API parity with the UI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
